paper_ref: Loh and Warachka, forthcoming in Management Science, October 2011
economic_intuition: Investors underreact to consecutive same-signed earnings surprises due to the gambler's fallacy; positive streaks predict high future returns and negative streaks predict low future returns.
detailed_definition: A positive streak is at least two consecutive positive quarterly earnings surprises; a negative streak is at least two consecutive non-positive/negative quarterly earnings surprises. Earnings surprise equal to zero is classified as negative.
cat_form: categorical signal mapped to long/short legs

source_details: stock price at the end of the prior month

formula.paper_expression: Streak = +1 for positive streaks; -1 for negative streaks; streak length at least two
